hypotheses.B1_state_basis_recovers_natural_pcs: State-SVD-32 improves natural-write-PCA median correlation over semantic-32 by at least 0.15 on every corpus.
hypotheses.B2_semantic_basis_recovers_map_outliers: Semantic-32 improves top query-map-component correlation over state-SVD-32 by at least 0.10 on every corpus.
hypotheses.B3_hybrid_serves_both: Hybrid-64 is within 0.05 of the better semantic-32/state-SVD-64 result for semantic, natural-write-PCA, and map-outlier queries on every corpus.
hypotheses.B4_hybrid_beats_random: Hybrid-64 exceeds random-64 median correlation for all query families on every corpus.
hypotheses.B5_objective_tradeoff: Semantic-32 has higher map-outlier fidelity while state-SVD-32 has higher whole-write centered R2 on every corpus.
